bullets.text: As an individual contribution to a supervised capstone, implemented reusable Python workflow modules and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, used regular-expression and dictionary rules to extract organization and date spans from public research abstracts, then compared extracted spans with provided manually checked examples.

Under supervision, joined research abstract identifiers to bibliographic metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
As an individual contribution to a supervised course project, implemented reusable Python workflow modules and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, joined public policy excerpt identifiers to provided metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
As an individual contribution to a supervised research team, implemented reusable Python workflow modules and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, validated pandas merges for public news summaries and publication metadata with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, then used Matplotlib to visualize changes in group comparisons under alternative cleaning rules.
